body:
🤖 Reopening this issue at the user's request to extend the search across merged-PR history, without the September restriction. The completed September experiment and its [conclusion](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/issues/28#issuecomment-6352713291) remain a separate scientific baseline; its two exports were not the yield from all repository history.

The user proposed a **$100 total OpenRouter budget**. Conservatively count the existing **$5.975286** toward that issue ceiling, leaving **$94.024714**. No new model charges, Docker builds, controls or remote jobs have occurred. Keep requests serial, record actual charges and reserve sufficient budget before dispatch; a software stop observer is not a provider-enforced billing cap. Only upstream's built-in model calls are permitted.

A read-only metadata query counts **23,285 merged PRs** across the same ten repos: SAMtools 735, Scanpy 1,941, MACS 157, OpenMS 5,671, LAMMPS 3,367, Matchms 435, Cobrapy 590, MMseqs2 87, MNE 7,888 and OHIF 2,414. These are counts, not an enumerated candidate manifest, suitability estimates or validation results. [Exact count query/results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/b62bd6d01d6082b67fce639bd66fc9303bbffed2/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/history-wide/history-counts.json).

Removing `since`/`until` is supported configuration, but upstream also caps its fetch at `min(limit * 3, 1000)` and filters dates after fetching. Full-history discovery therefore needs a small explicit pagination adaptation; old date windows alone do not bypass this cap. The next stage is to checkpoint that concrete adaptation and enumerate history, then process bounded batches with an explicit remaining backlog. Do not claim an exhaustive runtime sweep from a finite batch.

The [revised scope and budget](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/b62bd6d01d6082b67fce639bd66fc9303bbffed2/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/history-wide/scope.md) preserve the original eligibility, paired validation, export and grading behavior; no extra LLM repair loop, package/interpreter fixes, parser/transport repairs or candidate handpicking. Concrete native batch/CPU/time settings remain to be checkpointed before execution. Only existing authorized reserved TRC CPUs are in scope, with independent controls budgeted separately. The issue body remains a concise current-status summary; detailed updates and log/artifact links remain in comments.
